_notice: Generated by services/agents/source-ingestion-agent/run.mjs. Each factor is either real fetched data or an explicit 0 with a note explaining why -- never a guess. See each restaurant's `factors` field for a per-factor value/note/updated_at audit trail, `previous_score`/`score_delta`/`delta_since` for the real change-since-last-time (from score-history.json, not a demo placeholder), and services/agents/OPERATIONS.md for the daily/weekly cadence this runs on. healthInspection is real as of 2026-10-17 -- resolved from Maricopa County's public food-inspection portal (envapp.maricopa.gov), rotated daily across the roster (HEALTH_INSPECTION_DAILY_BUDGET); `factors.healthInspection.updated_at` is the source of truth for when it was last checked. reviewSentiment is a SCORED factor derived from the same Google review sample as dish/service mentions -- recent-review star average plus praised-dish and flagged-service signals, no raw review text stored -- and replaces the former editorial/press factor (press coverage biased toward marketing spend, not diner trust). `dish_mentions` / reviewSentiment are WEEKLY and rotated (see PLACE_DETAILS_DAILY_BUDGET in run.mjs) -- the real GetPlaceRequest quota on this unbilled project turned out to be 100/day, so each restaurant's reviews refresh at least every other week, not every week; `dish_mentions_updated_at` and `factors.reviewSentiment.updated_at` are the source of truth for when each was last checked. dish_mentions/service_mentions/recent_reviews are a derived-only summary of Google's up-to-5 most relevant reviews (term/mentions/avg_rating) -- they feed reviewSentiment's score and the UI, never storing raw review text (see the DISH MENTIONS comment atop run.mjs for the legal reason).
